# ProtonDB test data

`game-*.json.gz` and `counts.json` are a small, trimmed extract of
[ProtonDB](https://www.protondb.com) data, recorded with
`scripts/record_fixtures.py`. Only the fields autoproton uses are kept; no
usernames or avatars.

ProtonDB data is made available under the
[Open Database License (ODbL)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/),
with individual contents under the
[Database Contents License](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/dbcl/1-0/).
